scope: New-machine reproduction using the low-level CV and native adaptation entry points

cv.checkpoint_selection: fixed last.pt at update 3000; no holdout checkpoint selection
cv.candidate_selection: mean of three full holdout Greedy corpus BLEU scores, then mean chrF2, then candidate order
cv.grouping: verified talk ID or normalized English source connected components; source-only fallback when joint components exceed frozen feasibility bounds
cv.fit_scope: fresh BPE8k on each fold training partition; fresh full-training BPE after selection

adapt.selection: complete validation Greedy BLEU, then chrF2, then earliest update; learning-rate ties use candidate order

limitations: Historical test outcomes were already known when the original study was designed.
CV selects smoothing at 3000 updates, not at 12000 updates.
Three seeds do not establish statistical significance.
OPUS pretraining overlap with IWSLT/TED cannot be ruled out.
The study and study_complete whole-study controllers retain historical dependencies; use the documented low-level reproduction route.
